findings.title: SRAM macro identity and capacity are not derived from the row/configuration/resource contract
findings.evidence: A consistently rehashed manifest plus TSMC-like .ds naming TOTALLY_WRONG_UNBOUND_MACRO passes _validate_extraction_receipt and contributes 0.2 mm2. The parser checks only manifest==.ds macro and library; neither macro name nor depth/width/bit capacity is compared with the 240 KiB resource/configuration.
findings.required_fix: Add an exact per-configuration memory inventory rooted in the common resource manifest. Parse compiler organization/capacity and require the ordered macro set, instance multiplicity, total bytes, ports and macro identities to match it. Include that projection in run_id and the extraction receipt.

findings.title: PT libraries and every corner are manifest assertions rather than native-report-derived identities
findings.evidence: UNPARSED_PTPX_LIBRARY, UNPARSED_SETUP_LIBRARY, UNPARSED_HOLD_LIBRARY and five UNPARSED_FAKE_CORNER strings pass the complete extraction receipt. Only the DC library and SRAM library are parsed; even the .ds Slow/0.9V/125C tuple is not compared with corners.sram_macro.
findings.required_fix: Root native report_environment/library reports for DC/PT/PTPX, parse library DB identity and operating condition, and compare the .ds PVT tuple to the declared SRAM corner. Remove free-form corner/library fields that are not report-derived.

findings.title: Run provenance does not distinguish hand-written native-looking text from a Synopsys execution
findings.evidence: An independently hand-written five-report set with Synopsys-like headers passes the run manifest and extraction receipt. The run manifest roots extraction argv only; it has no generation argv, netlist, SDC, library DB, SAIF, tool log or exit-status SHA. Design is only a text header.
findings.required_fix: Add a tool-run receipt rooted in exact dc_shell/pt_shell/PTPX argv and exit status, synthesized netlist/DDC, SDC, library DB inventory, parasitic/SAIF inputs and complete tool log. Bind all roots into run_id before accepting the native reports.

findings.title: Standalone extractor accepts a symlinked report path
findings.evidence: _load_manifest resolves the path before candidate.is_symlink(), so the symlink identity is erased. The builder's inherited _file_spec catches this, so the current registry admission path remains fail-closed.
findings.required_fix: Reject raw path components and symlinks before resolve in the extractor itself.

findings.title: Standalone extractor accepts parent-traversal components
findings.evidence: reports/../reports/area.rpt is accepted by extract_from_manifest. The builder rejects it through secure_repo_file, limiting this to direct-CLI hardening.
findings.required_fix: Require nonabsolute repo-relative paths with no empty, dot or dot-dot components before resolve.
